notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.6.1 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since the last patch - we have been working on a lot of stuff behind the scenes (Full version content, translations). We got 4 new Darkness items for you to try out. To find them, enable Rotating Demo Content in the in-game options. 

The biggest change in this update is the Block rework. Block used to be based on the Block chance stat. Now, shields can generate a Block Token that will shield you from exactly the next hit. Shields generate Block tokens in various ways. Let us know how you like this change and the different shields!

Full Changelog 0.6.1:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] “Block” now works based on block tokens that are generated by your shield. All shields and block chance talents are changed to account for this!
[*] Added “Dodge on Hit” chance behaving similarly to the old block, but triggering “On Dodge” effects
[*] Rotated out Faraday’s Chainmail, Helmholtz Helm and Zeus’ Thunderpants
[*] Rotated in Grand Lich’s Kneecap, Grand Lich’s Skull, Grand Lich’s Bone Feet and Grand Lich’s Soul!
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[u]Wands[/u]
[list]
[*] Impractically Large Greatsword now contests enemy projectiles
[*] Improved Ball Lightning handling
[/list]
[u]Talents[/u]
[list]
[*] Samael’s Final Form: Increased AOE and Damage (100 -> 120)
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemies being able to survive out of screen
[*] Fixed ice blocks sometimes not spawning the the enemy was oneshot
[*] Sparkies now face in the correct direction
[*] Fixed a translation issue with “Fire”
[/list]
[b]Visuals & other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash indicator is now under the player character’s feet
[*] Improved talent layouting
[*] Remade Firemaw & Icemaw VFX
[*] Performance Optimisations
[*] Unified many fonts
[*] Ball Lightning now has screen shake
[*] Iceblocks now flash when kicked
[*] Added 0.33x resolution scaling
[/list]

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.6.0 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today we released patch 0.6.0 for the demo, marking a major version!
The demo has been progressing very nicely, to a point that we start to plan for the final release. So at some point, we need to have actual full version exclusive content. We thought about that for a while and think we found the coolest way to do it:
We will make large portions of items, talents etc. available in a rotation for several weeks. This way, you can take a look at it, test it and give feedback. 

This patch is centered around 2 things: 
1) We vastly improved controller support, making it almost feature-complete. 
2) We introduced new content, some permanent and some of it rotating.

Here are the full patch notes for version 0.6.0:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[u]6 NEW TALENTS:[/u]
[*] Ice Blocks, Shatter, Azrael’s Ice Demise, Azrael's Final Form, Samael’s Eternal Infernal Burnal, Samael's Final Form

[u]FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT:[/u]
[*] Any number of controllers can be used and switched on the fly - you don’t need to change it in the options
[*] Added button rebinding for controller
[*] Now shows correct (and controller type dependent) button prompts
[*] ADDED CONTROLLER VIBRATION - Can be adjusted in the options
[*] Added deadzone configuration for both sticks
[*] Players 1 and 2 can now both play with a controller

[u]ROTATING CONTENT:[/u]
[*] Added rotating content for the demo, that will only be accessible temporarily for testing (and of course included in the full version). They can be enabled in the options. Temporary items can not be added to the collection. Please help us test this content!
[*] This version includes preview versions of the missing Electricity set items and two Electricity talents

[u]OPPORTUNITY TALENTS:[/u]
[*] Added Opportunity talents, that are only offered once per run. Some talents are Opportunities now. Let us know how you like them, they are an experiment.

[u]ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS:[/u]
[*] You can now keybind switching to one specific wand
[*] You can now keybind the 4 individual attacks to keys and the wand switches automatically (this should offer an alternative way to cast that makes it easier to keep track of the current wand)
[*] Added autoaiming options: off, assisted (you can influence aiming, but it snaps), full
[*] Added an autofire toggle button
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Poison now ticks half as fast, but for twice the damage per tick
[*] Burn now ticks half as fast, but for twice the damage per tick
[/list]
[u]Wands[/u]
[list]
[*] Sun Strike: Reduced delay from 0.8 to 0.3
[*] Firebolt: Improved trajectory to converge earlier
[/list]
[u]Talents[/u]
[list]
[*] Thermite now requires a Fire item instead of a Neutral item
[/list]
[u]Items[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased Scale Mail Cold resistance 20% -> 20/30/40 %
[/list]
[u]Dashes[/u]
[list]
[*] All dashes now reset the player knockback
[/list]
[u]Modules[/u]
[list]
[*] Reduced the speed of the fast scrolling conveyor belt module
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed wand switch not being buffered while charging
[*] Fixed Dark fire kills not being counted
[*] Fixed a crash related to electrified water after multiple runs
[*] Fixed Spell areas being shown for a moment after the player spawns
[*] Fixed Menu-cursor mode activating after player 2 logged off
[*] Fixed upgrades being pickable through the stats screen with keyboard or controller
[*] Fixed a crash with p2 switching character and the damage meter
[/list]
[b]Visuals & minor changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Thermite now changes the burn visual
[*] Deep Freeze now changes the ice visuals
[*] Made screen wide heal particles more responsive
[/list]

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.6 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This is one of our largest content patches so far, bringing a bunch of new enemies, reworked patterns and new Dungeon modules. We also added an Easter egg themed talent. We wish you a Happy Easter!

[*] Ball Lightning: damage 90 -> 100

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.5 (Demo)
notes.content:
Patch 0.5.5 for Furcifer's Fungeon is here! We added a feature that was requested a lot: a monster book where you can find out details about the Fungeon's fauna. It also counts how often you have defeated any type of monster, and shows their elemental vulnerabilities! 

The Frightening Frog, for example, is weak to Fire and Electricity, but resilient against Cold attacks. Cold? Yes, we have renamed Water to Cold, as it's a better representation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006253/503db32bdf3925e7fa1f0d171ef4da407f8cff0f.png[/img]

Anyway, check out the details in the full changelog for 0.5.5:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a MONSTER MANUAL (accessible from title screen and inventory)
[*] Also added monster-specific elemental vulnerabilities!
[*] Effective/Ineffective damage is now shown next to the damage number (see Options to turn all damage numbers on)
[*] Enemies now can deal elemental damage by contact, which should make elemental resistances more useful!
[*] Damage numbers are now colored based on their element
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed “The Grind” stat bonus not being applied
[*] Fixed background elements being hoverable through the levelup screen

[*] Prevented skeletons from standing inside enemies
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Cloud hitting stuff it really should not
[*] Fixed a crash when closing the Fungeon Report with 2 players
[*] Damage done by player 2 is now shown in the damage meter
[*] Fixed “Heat Disposal” not being accessible through “Hammer Juggling”
[*] Fixed tutorial slimes and Cactor sometimes levitating
[*] Game now ignores the first click when the window was not in focus
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[u]Talents[/u]
[list]
[*] Reduced “Lumberjack” coin chance to 50% (compensating for the coin value change last patch)
[*] “Consume Friends” now requires “Shared Blood”
[*] “Necromastery” now requires “Undead Horde”
[*] Reduced “Necromastery” requirements from 100 to 50 skeleton kills
[*] “Flash Friends” now gives +20% skeleton movespeed permanently

[list]
[*] Blue Orb charge time increased by 10%
[*] Dragon now pierces up to 2 weak targets
[*] Player 2 now gains dash damage, critical hit chance, and critical damage with each character level
[/list]

[b]Visuals & minor changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed “Water” element to “Cold” to work better with the item set and coming content
[*] Improved Bee and Big Bee animations
[*] Improved enemy animations, especially jumps are less janky now
[*] Improved enemy hit feedback
[*] Added unique particles for items of each element, also improved the sparks
[*] Marked the area to pray to the furcifer statue with a glow
[*] Player is now forced to take an item once, so new players cannot miss it ……
[*] Damage number direction now works better for strong enemies and late game
[*] Improved German localization

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.4 (Demo)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we finished another update for the demo! The big new features this time are [b]floor mods[/b] that change up the environment and enemies, and a [b]German localization[/b]!

With the mods we hope to make your runs a bit more varied and challenging. We want to add a lot more different mods in the future. Let us know how you like them.

The German translation was done by us. Our publisher IndieArk is translating the game (including the demo) into several Asian languages. If you want to help localizing the game to other languages, send us a DM on Discord!

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.5.1 (Demo)
notes.content:
Since the 0.5.0 update a lot of new players have played the demo, and we have received lots of feedback - thank you guys!
In this patch, we added a much requested feature: a [b]talent viewer[/b]! It allows you to see what talents there are and what is currently in the talent pool. It should also give you a feeling for how much more content there is to come ;)

We also added three new talents, and some other awesome stuff! Check out the full patch notes below:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] The complete talent tree can now be viewed ingame. It marks which ones you have seen and picked. Within the run, you see which ones you have chosen and which ones you have the requirements for.
[*] NEW CHARACTER TALENTS: “Feathers of Justice”, “Yoink!” and “Time Warp”
[*] Trees can now be killed (they are really tanky earlygame tho)
[*] The player can no longer be squeezed to death by the screen border, instead, Furcifer will save you
[*] Dash can now be bound to the mouse
[*] Mouse4 and Mouse5 buttons can now be used for key bindings
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Detonate Ball Lightning explosion sometimes not hitting targets 
[*] Fixed damage numbers moving weird on some systems and when vsync was off
[*] Fixed dash cooldown digits being cut after “.”
[*] Fixed Rage-Flames coming after closing the chest even when not stealing when you still had rage left over
[*] Fixed talents rounding their parameters, leading to inaccurate display (such as Gold Conductor duration being 0.25 but displayed as 0.3)
[*] Fixed “Quest complete” marker not being paused when the game pauses
[*] Fixed that fungeon color grading could be dragged into menus
[*] Fixed paw cursor being offset
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Reduced Dark Fire (boss) hp by 10%
[*] Reduced chance of encountering Dark Fire from 30% to 20% per dungeon
[*] Increased Wilhelm base Intelligence by 2

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.9 (Demo)
notes.content:
We wish you a Happy New Year!
Over the holidays we've polished the heck out of the demo.

This patch brings a lot of visual improvements, balancing tweaks and even cool new features! 

Take a look at your inventory during a run, you can now find a damage meter there, giving you more insight into how much damage you dealt with your spells and items.
The leaderboard runcards also include a damage meter from now on.

We also added a ton of options such as the CRT effect to customize your Fungeon experience!

Here's the full changelog for 0.4.9:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] DAMAGE METER is now shown during & after the run. It also shows for runs in the leader board
[*] Added retro CRT scanline shader to options
[*] Resistances now stack multiplicatively (50% + 50% = 75%), floor-wise reduction is removed, and resistance cap is removed
[*] Added options: Seasonal talents can all be enabled, disabled or seasonal. Text speed can be adjusted. Damage numbers for crits can now also be turned off.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed “Overwhelming Power” not increasing in size
[*] Block values were displayed with diminishing returns already applied, which was hard to understand. It now shows the correct (higher) amount
[*] Fixed sunstrike collision being flipped 90°
[*] Fixed a bug where bees were sometimes falsely being spawned as summons (and therefore taking damage and giving no gold)
[*] Fixed wands/dash in esc-menu having the interactable cursor despite not being interactable
[*] Fixed a crash when clicking an item on the Fungeon ticket
[*] Fixed trees being hit by the spikes in the miniboss room
[*] Fixed a tooltip remaining on screen
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased player base movespeed by 10%
[*] Rescaled the enemy maximum number to be lower early game and higher late game, reduced the cast speed and movement speed of late game enemies to compensate
[*] Reduced tree collision size
[/list]
[u]Spells:[/u]
[list]
[*] Reworked Ball Lightning: damage per tick is higher, tick rate lower, the ball is smaller, bounces more and moves differently. The ball can be detonated ever 5s for an much stronger explosion.
[*] Shock Hands: hitbox now extends more towards the player to hit stuff below you, knockback now goes away from the player
[*] Poison Spray: now applies knockback away from the player instead of from the telegraph middle. Also increased knockback from 100 to 150 per tick.
[*] Firebolt: reduced knockback 300 -> 250

[*] Trinkets max health modifier 25 -> 40

[list]
[*] Soul of the Honey Badger: now additionally reduced damage taken for 3s when dropping below 50% hp
[*] Phoenix Badger: now shoots a flame nova when it activates, heal increased from 35% -> 50%
[*] Skeleton base damage reduced from 70 to 60 
[*] Necromastery: bonus damage reduced from 50 to 40 (they should still deal good damage…)
[*] Friend Combustion: damage 75 -> 100
[*] Critical Zap: cooldown now is target-wise, making it much better aoe
[*] Evasiveness: now also triggers on block, removed cooldown. Now gives +5 agility instead of +20% movespeed
[*] Gold Conductor: now gives attack speed instead of dash rate, bonus 30 -> 100, duration 1s -> 0.3s
[/list]
[b]Improved Descriptions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dragon Tail now mentions the number of flames
[*] Improved the amount of information in wand tooltips
[*] Added additional keywords for burn and freeze with tooltips
[/list]
[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaf particles now do not spawn in the tutorial
[*] Improved some items
[*] Improved Venom Spit
[*] Improved Sword particles
[*] Skeleton critical hits damage numbers are now colored red and play the crit animation
[*] Reduced shotgun screenshake
[*] Added a popup message when you are too poor to buy an item from the Fungeon Report
[*] Tooltips: Added an underline to highlight keywords that can be hovered for a tooltip
[*] Talent icons are reactively downscaled instead of spilling over their boxes
[*] Improved talent icon shader
[*] Restructured the esc menu
[*] Reorganized Options menu
[*] Improved the UI buttons
[*] Juiced up the leaderboard

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.6 (Demo)
notes.content:
In this patch, we reworked the "Knight" talent tree and gave it its own mechanic. The "Slash" is a close combat attack that scales with your contact damage - this should make the stat way more viable. 

There are many balance changes and fixes, as always. Here's the complete changelog:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added “Tactical Tackle” Talent
[*] Reworked the Knight talent tree, replacing stat-only talents with the SLASH, dealing your contact damage without the need to run into things (essentially 5 new talents)
[*] Reworked “Heavy” talent. It now gives block chance and regenerates HP on block
[*] Reworked “Evasiveness”. It now refreshes your dash when you take damage. (10s cd)
[*] Reworked Cleansing Amulet: regeneration now triggers when you are below 50% hp. It also gives 50% increased hp regen
[*]Increased coin pickup amount now increase with floor, Reduced luck-based pickup amount from 2% to 1%. Let us know how this changes the exp you get. It *should* give roughly the same exp for high luck runs and more for low-luck runs.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tesla Buckler cooldown was not working at all
[*] Enemies had the same stat caps as the player, resulting in some stats not scaling in very late regions (this might need some rebalancing)
[*] Hopefully fixed a rare issue where the tutorial cactus died before landing, softlocking the game. We could not reproduce the issue, let us know should it still happen
[*] Fixed some tooltips persisting after talent pick
[*] Fixed tutorial slime poses
[*] Fixed screenshake slightly effecting your aiming
[*] Fixed some aiming jankiness when hellfire ray was aimed close to the player
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player projectiles are now much more resilient against aoe damage zones
[*] Strength scaling changed from 120 + 7* str -> 60 + 10*str
[*] Regen per strength 0.1 -> 0.15
[*] Player now has 10% more resistances in Doom and 20% more in Death (we reduced the reduction)
[*] ZOP damage from 4% current hp to 50 + 2%. ZAPs can no longer cause other ZAP effects.
[*] Skeletons now have an 0.5s invulnerability time after taking damage
[*] Skeleton base movespeed increased by 10%
[/list]

Items:
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the amount of speed shoes give you
[*] Ampere’s Gauntlets: ZAP chance 30/40/50 -> 25/30/35
[*] Ice Armor: shards 3 -> 9/10/11. Damage 20 -> 40. Also works on block now. Now has 5s cooldown.
[*] Grand Lich's Rib Cage: skeletons 2-> 3. Now also works on block. Added cooldown of 3.
[*] Firemaw and Flame sword: no longer add “Fire damage” tags to the talent pool
[*] Thor’s Hammer: 40/45/50, Electricity damage 10%/15%/20% -> 10%/12.5%/15%, the actual hammer damage is increased by 5
[*] Icicle Spear: projectile damage 50 -> 70
[*] Flame Sword: damage 50/55/60 -> 90
[*] Firemaw: damage 40/45/50 -> 60/65/70
[*] Calm Keeper: bonus attack speed 6/8/10 -> 6/7/8
[/list]
Spells:
[list]
[*] Rainbow catcher cooldown 1.5 -> 1.0
[*] Throw Sword: Reduced sword turn-rate while thrown, increased charge time of “throw” to 1.3s to prevent canceling mid air
[*] Shock Hands: Slow 50% for 1.5s -> 25% for 1s. Player speed buff 50% → 30% for 1s
[*] Dashes
[*] Britta: dash invulnerability time after dash 0.1 -> 0.05, cooldown 2s -> 2.5s
[*] Wilhelm: dash cooldown 4 -> 3.5, the aoe lingers 0.1s longer now, making it easier to hit
[/list]

[list]
[*] Split Devastating Crits into two talents. Also reduced the extra damage to 30% and the critical damage to 35%
[*] Conductive Research: only worked on Electricity damage without mentioning it. It now has a 50% chance to ZAP on Electricity damage and 20% on every other type of damage
[*] Scythe Juggling: damage 60 -> 30 (the damage of the weapon when picked up as an item is unchanged)
[*] Up Your Arsenal: effect damage 40% -> 30%, now gives additional +30 contact damage
[*] Epic Effect Damage: 100% -> 80%
[*] Wet Dog: Intelligence -> 12, water damage 30% -> 10%
[*] Brave Bird: Strength 10 -> 12
[*] Character-specific talents now have a minimum level of 5, removed other restrictions
[*] Toughness: additionally gives +20% max hp
[*] Flash Friends: now requires “Precision”
[*] Skeleton Shields: now requires 30 block chance
[*] Friend Combustion: damage 60 -> 75
[*] Stronker Chonker: now gives 10% damage resistance
[/list]
Trinkets:
[list]
[*] Critical rate average on trinkets 5% -> 4%, Crit damage 10% -> 8%
[*] Contact damage on trinkets 10 -> 20
[/list]

[list]
[*] Dash cooldown now shows an approximation when it is done, not the base value
[*] Improved starting screen artwork
[*] Presskit is now linked in starting screen
[/list]

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.5 (Demo)
notes.content:
In this patch we introduce summoning as a game mechanic! The new items and talents allow you to summon an undead horde of skeletons!

Full Changelog 0.4.5:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new darkness ITEMS
[*] 13 new darkness TALENTS: You can now summons skeletons!
[*] Agility now gives 1% attack speed, 1% movespeed, 1% dash rate instead of 0% attack speed, 2% movespeed, 2% dash rate per point
[*] Strength now additionally gives 3 contact damage per point
[*] Intelligence now gives +1% effect damage instead of 1% attack speed
[*] Shockhands now has a final hit launching enemies away
[*] Player projectiles can now pierce enemy projectiles for only a slight reduction in power. This should be huge for projectile spells late game.
[*] Removed the cap to basic attributes of 200, because you guys actually got there for some reason
[*] +1 stat pickups are now affected by the pickup range stat
[*] If you somehow manage to get past “THE END” (which you really should not be able to, players should die far earlier, but you guys keep breaking the game in unexpected ways), you now take increasing damage ticks that should guarantee your demise
[*] ESC menu now shows coins gathered in the run, instead of the total amount
[*] ESC now shows more stats when you hover “> Other Stats<”
[*] Added even more space for trinkets and talents in UI
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]

[*] Fixed a visual bug in the leaderboard run cards when the score entry’s player started with gloves
[*] Fixed a crash when dying while Zapzap was happening
[*] Fixed unbuyable Maxwell Boots
[*] Snow Shoes no longer freeze without having the freeze talent
[*] Fixed tooltip not being visible after upgrading an item
[*] Fixed leaderboard run-cards stacking in some cases
[*] Fixed ball lightning sound effect being unmutable
[*] Gun is now visible
[/list]

[*] Hellfire Ray now has +10% damage and increased knockback when the enemy is close and reduced knockback when they are far to keep them in the area.

[*] Sun Cream: fire resistance 50% -> 40%
[*] Floaties: water resistance 35% -> 20%
[*] Sneakers of Speed: movespeed 25% -> 20%
[*] Steel Blade: block chance 5%/7.5%/10% -> 10%/ 12.5%/15%
[*] Thor’s Hammer now additionally gives 10%/12.5%/15% effect damage. Its damage now scales 20/25/30 instead of always 20.
[*] Venom Cloud (from venom enchantments) can now only hit you once
[*] Fire Maw: damage 24/24/24 -> 40/45/50
[*] Ice Breath: damage 48 -> 60
[*] Calmkeeper now has a stack limit of 5

This patch brings new Electricity items and talents to Furcifer's Fungeon!
Of course, we are also improving balance and added some quality of life features.

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.3 (Demo)
notes.content:
We are back with another update bringing lots of balance tweaks and some quality of life.

From now on, scores submitted to the leaderboard have the build attached, including the talents and items you picked. Just click on entries and see what other players built!

We immensly buffed the dashes, they should be a viable offensive option now! 

Here's the complete changelog:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard now shows the players builds! (not working retrospectively)
[*] Tumbling can no longer deal damage to the player - bouncing them into you is good for you now

notes.title: Furcifer's Fungeon 0.4.2 (Demo)
notes.content:
We have received lots of feedback for the demo!
So here's some QOL (damage numbers, health bar HUD, better descriptions and more), some bugfixes, balancing changes as well as some fresh new talents!

Here's the complete changelog:

New features:
[list]
[*] Added optional damage numbers (see Options)
[*] Added optional player health bar (see Options)
[*] Weapons now indicate cooldown with their brightness
[*] Added “Adventurer” talent
[*] Added “Overwhelming Power” talent
[*] Added “The Grind” talent
[*] Temporal buff globes now say what they do on pickup!
[*] Arrow keys now can be used for moving by default
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] Steel Dragon should finally work
[*] Fixed a bug that left the paddle dealing damage when switched while charging
[*] Fixed broken parameters on demonic items
[*] Fixed a crash when the options were opened twice at the same time and then closed
[*] Fixed enemies being pushed by the left border
[*] Fixed weird aiming with the fire-laser
[*] Game now pauses on focus loss
[/list]
Balance:
[list]
[*] Reduced Lightning Strike cooldown
[*] Reduced the requirements for “Steel Dragon” from 2 neutral items to only 1
[*] Slightly nerfed Bone Scythe
[*] Sir Honkalot now has more invincibility after dashing, allowing offensive dashes
[*] Rebalanced heart pickup to heal a bit less early and a bit more late game
[*] Mage armor: 1% block for 3 int -> 1% block for 4 int, it should still be good
[*] Ruby shield block scaling from 10%/15%/20% -> 10%/12.5%/15%
[*] Swarmer enemies (mushrooms and bees) move slower but have more hp, this should offer a bit more space to dodge. Also adjusted how they move close to the player.
[*] Stronker Chonker 4hp/s -> 3hp/s
[/list]
Improved description texts
[list]
[*] Spell damage (now “Wand damage”)
[*] Block stat
[*] Contact damage stat
[*] Dragon Claws item
[*] Renamed “Dash cast rate” -> “Dash rate”
[*] Renamed the neutral element: “Physical damage” -> “Neutral damage” “None item” -> “Neutral item”
[/list]
